title: The ledger and feedback-flag memo files of kf_fresh and kbfacts grow without bound in the shared _cache, one per worktree or sandbox path
goal: kf_fresh's ledger memo and kbfacts' flags memo drop the memo files whose source path (a ledger csv, a query-log store directory) no longer exists when they write a new one, so a shared _cache holds a bounded count of them, and a memo of a source that still exists is kept and still hit

run:
import glob, json, os, shutil, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
idx = tempfile.mkdtemp()
os.environ["KB_INDEX"] = idx
import kf_fresh, kbfacts, ql_store
for i in range(30):
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    p = os.path.join(d, "ledger.csv")
    open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="").write("id,text\nS100,a\nS101,b\n")
    kf_fresh._ledger_index(p, "id")
    st = os.path.join(d, "store")
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(st, "2026-10"))
    open(os.path.join(st, "2026-10", "20261001T000000Z-aaaaaaaa.jsonl"), "w").write(json.dumps({"run": "x"}) + "\n" + json.dumps({"id": "e1", "day": "2026-10-01"}) + "\n")
    kbfacts._flag_reports(st, ql_store.run_stats(st))
    if i < 29:
        shutil.rmtree(d)
led = len(glob.glob(os.path.join(idx, "ledger-*.json")))
flg = len(glob.glob(os.path.join(idx, "flags-*.json")))
print("ledger memos", led, "flags memos", flg, "after 29 of 30 source paths were removed")
sys.exit(0 if led <= 3 and flg <= 3 else 1)

import glob, os, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
idx = tempfile.mkdtemp()
os.environ["KB_INDEX"] = idx
import kf_fresh
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
p = os.path.join(d, "ledger.csv")
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="").write("id,text\nS100,a\nS101,b\n")
a = kf_fresh._ledger_index(p, "id")
q = os.path.join(d, "other.csv")
open(q, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="").write("id,text\nS100,a\n")
kf_fresh._ledger_index(q, "id")
b = kf_fresh._ledger_index(p, "id")
n = len(glob.glob(os.path.join(idx, "ledger-*.json")))
print(n, a == b)
sys.exit(0 if n == 2 and a == b and a else 1)
